answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 25096 Country: India Title: I have pronounced talaq thice (at one go) to my wife in pressure because of her uncle over the phone. there were no witness and I went back to my wife within the iddah period and told her that she is till my wife and I want to take her back. Is she still in my nikah Question: I have pronounced talaq thice (at one go) to my wife in pressure because of her uncle over the phone. there were no witness and I went back to my wife within the iddah period and told her that she is till my wife and I want to take her back. Is she still in my nikah Answer ID: 25096 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1418/D=309/K=1431) If you confess giving three talaqs, your wife was divorced with three irrevocable talaqs whether there was any witness or not. After pronouncing three talaqs, you cannot take her back. However, if you want to take your wife back, then after passing her iddah (if she is pregnant then after giving birth , otherwise after passing three maturation) she should marry to someone and they have sexual relationship. I Now, if the second husband gives her talaq by consent or he passes away, she, having passed iddah period, can marry you. There is no other solution available for that. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
